integrity_notes: Finite rational tests verify model examples only; the universal proof is analytic. No external independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to affine joins of at least two genuine convex quadrilaterals with nonnegative rational GBCs sharing a polynomial denominator. No assertion for higher-sided polygon factors, arbitrary signed barycentric coordinates, or unrelated rational maps. The general vanishing-order lemma is cited from the source and its hypotheses were inspected. Historical priority remains subject to independent research assessment.
title: Exact common-denominator degree on affine joins of quadrilaterals
